CardDescription.zh:
具有轻微致幻作用的植物，驱虫效果极强。

可以研磨成粉以增强效果。
CardDescription.en:
Mildly psychoactive plant with very strong insect repellent properties.

Can be ground into powder to enhance its effects.
CardDescription.ja:
Mildly psychoactive plant with very strong insect repellent properties.

Can be ground into powder to enhance its effects.

CardHelpSection.zh: 产地：酸性沼泽林隙 需求：高酸度、高湿度、低至中等养分。 效果：食物增强、驱虫、致幻。
CardHelpSection.en: Found: Acidic Swamp Clearings Growth Needs: High Acidity, High Hydration, Low to Mid Nutrients. Benefits: Meal Enhancer, Bug Repellant, Psychoactive.
